name: Steve McFarland
source:
The protagonist of Summer in Fairbrook. Steve is the stereotypical "city boy", and he is initially unused and estranged to the tranquil and lax lifestyle at the farm in Fairbrook. With the passing time though, he learns to adjust more.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Flower_Shop]Wikipedia[/url]]
